name: VIII° Gran Premio de San Sebastian

nar.text: On race Sunday, under a clear, warm autumn sun, a large crowd of visitors streamed to the long Lasarte circuit
The King of Spain personally had a brief conversation with each of the drivers before the start.
Filippo Sartorio withdrew his car and started in his brother Arrigo's #1 Maserati 26R
The flying start took place precisely at noon when the pilot car sped by before pulling off to the right, followed in short distance by the racing cars, three per row.

Varzi wins; Maggi second, 22 minutes behind, everyone else lapped.
Stoffel and Ferrand in the reliable old Peugeots had raced without stopping even once during the entire event and finished third and fourth respectively.
Behind them qualified the last two Bugattis of Fourny and de Maleplane, with Arrigo Sartorio's Maserati in seventh place. Last was Ferdinand Montier, the son, whose Montier-Special was flagged off.
